Priya: Morning async — quick check-in. What I did: finished kv-evict tuning PR and ran canary in eu-west. Blockers: seeing occasional 503s on batcher when queue depth spikes. Today: follow up on autoscaler backpressure, and pair with @Liam on alert tuning. Also filing a ticket for observability gaps. /cc @oncall-bot
Liam: Nice — did you capture request traces? If you can share a quick query I can run it on my end.
Priya: Yep pasted below. It's a Dune query that filters 503 by service. ```sql
select service, count(*) as errs from logs where status=503 and ts > now() - interval '15 minutes' group by service order by errs desc
```
Jordan: I saw a similar blip last night — looks correlated with kv-cache eviction cycle. FYI I opened RG-842 to increase batcher concurrency cap and added a fallback to smaller model variants. Ticket: RG-842
Marta: I'll update runbook with the tracing query and the temp mitigation steps. Link: https://play.redwood/runbooks/kv-evict (draft)
oncall-bot: Incident INC-492 created by Priya - priority P2. Assigned to Liam. https://incidents.redwood/INC-492
Liam: Taking INC-492. I'll start with heap and queue metrics. If can't find quick fix, we'll reroute traffic to dedicated pool.
Priya: Thanks. Minor note: noticed alert noise from eu-west embed-latency. Can we debounce the alert? Current rule is `avg(p99_lat_ms) > 400 over 5m` — maybe increase window to 10m. Thoughts?
Jordan: Agreed. Those autoscaler bursts cause transient p99s. +1 to 10m window. But keep a higher-severity alert for > 1s sustained.
Marta: I'll make a PR against alerts repo. ETA 1h.
Liam: Quick check — can someone post the autoscaler cooldown config? I want to confirm it's 30s not 10s.
Priya: Here: `autoscaler.cooldown_seconds=30` in `infra/services/batcher/config.yaml` (commit `c4f2a1`).
Jordan: Re: oncall handoff tonight, @Marta you're scheduled — anything you need from us before 5pm?
Marta: If INC-492 is still open, please escalate oncall handoff notes in the ticket. Otherwise I'm good.
Priya: Blocking note — need approval for a small capacity bump on Dedicated pool for 2 hours to soak the canary. Filed JIRA: RG-850 (link) — please +1 if ok.
Liam: +1 from me for bump.
Jordan: +1. Keep us posted.
Marta: I'll merge the alert debounce PR then. Ping me if the bump is applied.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll post a mini-followup in 30m with any INC-492 findings.
Liam: Roger. Also leaving a CR ping for `kv-evict-tuner` PR: https://git.redwood/pr/1284 — would appreciate review.
Jordan: Reviewed & left comments.
Priya: Awesome. TL;DR action items: Liam takes INC-492, Marta updates alerts runbook+PR, Jordan monitors batcher concurrency ticket RG-842, Priya requests capacity bump RG-850. Will sync in 30m. :white_check_mark:
